WILLIAM D. HASSETT, JR.  STATE OF IDAHO BUILDING  IN THE WAY OF A NEW  HOUSING LAW FOR 2020  TORONTO, ONTARIO  JULY 27, 1976

July 27, 1976

Ms. Norma Parish  The Tobacco Institute, Inc.  1776 K Street, N.W.  Washington, D.C. 20006

Dear Norma:

Mr. Hassett is out of town (and I assume Mr. Dwyer might be traveling, too).

I just talked with Mr. Jack Lewis of our area Grocery Manufacturers Representatives. They would definitely be interested in hearing Mr. Dwyer but they do not meet in the summer months. Should another visit in the September through May period be scheduled, by all means contact Mr. Lewis. The group consists of several tobacco products people and interested general membership and they would welcome a presentation by the Tobacco Institute.

Very truly yours,



Secretary to Mr. Hassett

CC: Mr. Hassett
